---
title: "Connection Extensions"
---

Database and data-source extensions can contribute connection providers to RHS-IA. A provider defines how a connection is registered, browsed, refreshed, and closed.

Install a provider only from a trusted publisher and follow its driver and credential setup. Provider behavior may depend on an active Python or R runtime.

Extension authors should expose metadata lazily, avoid logging secrets, and dispose connections when a session ends. General development guidance is in [Extension Development](../extensions/development.qmd).
